progressNote: The application remains unchanged so far. Database authorization, data integrity and release acceptance remain open.

steps.title: Establish a regression baseline
steps.summary: Local preservation and isolated regression checks are complete. Live database backup and remote staging are deferred by your instruction.

actions.text: Create a working branch and preserve existing uncommitted files.
actions.note: codex/regression-baseline; checksummed pre-change archive includes the untracked review work.

actions.text: Back up the live database schema and data.
actions.note: Deferred by user. The source archive includes local SQL files, not live database rows or deployed policies.

actions.text: Configure a remote staging database with representative records.
actions.note: Deferred by user. Fictional in-memory fixtures provide local isolation for this step.

actions.text: Add regression checks for failed writes, notes loss, concurrent updates, stale summaries and blocked storage.
actions.note: 18 checks: 5 pass; 13 reproduce known defects as expected failures. Strict mode reports 13 actual failures.

actions.text: Verify the build, fixture isolation and preservation of existing work.
actions.note: Build passed with unchanged asset hashes. 134 source/review files verified against the archive. No production database writes.

verify: Production build passes.
Recorded defects reproduce and unexpected failures remain zero.
Tests use an in-memory client and block external browser requests.
Existing work remains recoverable; live data backup is explicitly still deferred.

steps.title: Secure database access
steps.summary: Establish authenticated authorization before public release. Actual policy changes require a live backup and staging workflow first.

actions.text: Inspect deployed table grants and RLS settings against the supplied SQL.
Add authentication and restrict access to the permitted account or workspace members.
Enable RLS on all six application tables, including child-record ownership or membership policies.
Generate audit actor and timestamps server-side; restrict direct audit modification.
Roll out authentication and policies together so the legitimate user retains access.

verify: Anonymous and unrelated authenticated accounts cannot read or modify protected records.
The authorized user can complete intended workflows.
Forged audit actors and event edits are rejected.

steps.title: Stop false-success saves
steps.summary: Make every save result reflect confirmed persistence and give users a recoverable error when a write fails.

actions.text: Check every Supabase response for errors and confirm the expected record was affected.
Update client state after persistence, or add rollback for deliberate optimistic updates.
Add visible errors and retry controls; prevent repeated clicks while pending.
Separate a successful mutation from a failed subsequent refresh.

verify: Permission, network and missing-record failures never show Saved.
Denied writes preserve prior client state.
Reloaded state agrees with the save result.

steps.title: Fix IDs and concurrent mutations
steps.summary: Move allocation and related-record integrity into the database, while safely merging concurrent client updates.

actions.text: Migrate IDs to database generation; initialize the sequence above the highest existing ID.
Remove browser-side maxId + 1 allocation and obtain the inserted ID from the returned row.
Use functional state updates and serialize conflicting writes to the same idea.
Put related status/history/activity changes in database transactions.
Delete the parent once and use cascading foreign keys for child records.

verify: Concurrent creates receive unique IDs and deleted IDs are not reused.
Simultaneous changes retain both overrides.
Failures leave no partial status/history or destructive child-only changes.

steps.title: Prevent autosave data loss
steps.summary: Keep drafts alive across dialog closure and refresh; prevent older save responses overwriting newer text.

actions.text: Move draft ownership and save scheduling outside the modal lifecycle.
Flush changes before Close, Escape, backdrop dismissal, Edit and navigation; retain recoverable drafts on failure.
Serialize notes and score saves so older responses cannot overwrite newer values.
Refresh in the background without replacing the app shell.
Clean up score timers and keep input bounds consistent with persisted values.

verify: Notes survive immediate closure, Edit and background refresh.
Reversed network response timing preserves the latest value.
Failed saves retain the draft with Retry; page reload uses a recoverable local draft.

steps.title: Harden configuration and storage
steps.summary: Handle missing settings, denied storage and malformed values without blanking the application.

actions.text: Render a setup error before mounting App when connection settings are missing or invalid.
Centralize guarded reads/writes and validate JSON shapes, event fields, preferences and numeric bounds.
Use in-memory preferences when storage cannot persist.
Namespace local data by account and clean up deleted-idea data.

verify: Denied reads/writes, quota failures, malformed JSON, null and unexpected objects do not blank the app.
Missing URL/key produces a clear configuration error.
Healthy preferences still survive reload.

steps.title: Repair summaries and workflow feedback
steps.summary: Keep reporting synchronized with assignments and statuses, and make action feedback recover correctly.

actions.text: Make group/status maps explicit inputs to memoized calculations.
Consolidate scope and priority sorting; define Groups/Spaces and hidden-selection behavior.
Count triage decisions separately from skips and reset busy state in finally.
Restore action-button mounted state during effect setup so StrictMode remains usable.

verify: Assignment changes immediately refresh scoped totals and workspace metrics.
Failed triage actions recover and completed/deferred counts are accurate.
Action buttons return to idle in StrictMode; filters do not cause undisclosed hidden mutations.

steps.title: Make history and exports trustworthy
steps.summary: Show real decisions, recover pending events exactly once, and prevent silent export truncation.

actions.text: Remove fabricated fallback activity; correct legacy predecessor calculations and displayed counts.
Add an idempotent retry outbox with visible unavailable/full-buffer states.
Paginate reads and exports and identify incomplete data.
Use consistent local date boundaries and decision-event definitions; reject future timestamps.

verify: Empty or filtered-out history displays an honest empty state.
Offline events synchronize exactly once; repeated transitions remain visible.
More than 1,000 records export completely; Adelaide midnight/DST fixtures give correct counts.

steps.title: Resolve validation and business-rule inconsistencies
steps.summary: Make validation, scores, ranking and planning behavior match what the interface promises.

actions.text: Trim and validate values at the application boundary; add appropriate database constraints.
Keep unknown classifications visible instead of silently dropping ideas.
Document score range; show pain and manual adjustment in the breakdown; apply promised priority ordering.
Make matrix placement rules explicit and clarify sprint duration/scheduling semantics.

verify: Boundary values, whitespace-only entries and unknown classifications behave predictably.
Score explanation reconciles with the computed value.
Priority ties and planning rules are consistent across views.

steps.title: Fix accessibility and review-document defects
steps.summary: Make core workflows usable by keyboard, touch and assistive technology, and repair standalone review navigation.

actions.text: Add associated labels, native forms/buttons and accessible error messages.
Separate card-opening actions from checkboxes/advance controls; complete tabs and expanded/pressed states.
Improve modal isolation/focus restoration and score explanations for keyboard/touch.
Fix duplicate review IDs, unsafe hash lookup, lightbox keys and tall-slide tracking.
Check contrast, scalable text, target sizes and reduced-motion behavior.

verify: Core workflows complete using only a keyboard; checkbox Space does not open a card.
Screen readers announce controls, errors and states; focus returns correctly.
200% zoom and narrow screens remain usable; review links/lightboxes and reduced motion work.

steps.title: Perform focused cleanup and performance work
steps.summary: Reduce duplication and loading cost after correctness is protected by regression tests.

actions.text: Consolidate metadata, scoring, filtering and event helpers; lift nested component definitions.
Remove confirmed unused parameters, CSS and stale comments.
Narrow store subscriptions, parallelize independent reads and lazy-load inactive views/dialogs/seeds.
Split CSS while preserving cascade order; add lint, tests and build checks to CI.
Assess the 13 recorded dependency advisories and plan compatible, tested upgrades; declare Node/browser support baselines.

verify: Established scoring and UI behavior remain unchanged; focus is preserved.
Initial bundle decreases and requests remain bounded.
Regression checks pass on supported Chrome/Edge versions; advisory exposure is assessed.

steps.title: Apply the production release gate
steps.summary: Approve deployment only with evidence that authorization, data integrity and core interaction checks pass.

actions.text: Pass authorization allow/deny tests and confirm failed writes cannot appear successful.
Confirm drafts survive close/refresh and concurrent operations preserve data.
Reconcile summaries/exports with persisted records and pass core keyboard workflows.
Pass supported Chrome/Edge smoke tests, dependency checks and production build.
Record the release decision and evidence; track remaining low-impact work separately.

verify: Security and data-integrity blockers are resolved with passing tests.
No unresolved expected-failure test is treated as release approval.
Release is approved only after its acceptance gate; completing this plan does not itself deploy the app.

history.title: Local regression baseline completed
history.body: Branch created; existing work archived; 18 isolated checks added; build passed. Application behavior remains unchanged. Live backup and remote staging deferred by user.

history.body: The initial 12-step plan is preserved here. Statuses will be updated after verified work, with evidence and explicit deferrals.
